title: Gold's best week since 2020, Spotify & Applied Materials upgraded
text: Market Domination host Josh Lipton tracks several of Friday's top trending stock tickers, including gold's (GC=F) record-setting week, analysts' latest bullish calls on Spotify (SPOT), and Applied Materials (AMAT) getting upgraded.
